source_text: **(h) Recommended: a second reviewer.** A second reviewer, who has not seen the first reviewer's verdicts, re-checks each flag using steps (a) to (g). Report only the flags both reviewers agree on; list the disagreements separately as possible issues. - If both reviewers flag the same step but with different entries, report the flag, list both names as "label disputed", and resolve it with the family or cross-family tie-break. If the names are still split, report the more general of the two entries.
